== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes cannot gauge incoming damage. As such, they use Spirit Bond in response to ''any'' amount of incoming damage, even if that amount is below 50.

== Notes ==
* The count is refreshed when recast.
* Contrary to the description, Spirit Bond will heal whenever an ally ''would'' take a damage [[packet]] above 50, even if it is reduced to 50 or below by other means, such as [[Protective Spirit]] or [[Shield of Absorption]].
** Spirit Bond and Protective Spirit make the basis for the "[[600]]" monk in the 600/smite team used for [[farm]]ing.
* This skill can be used to mitigate the downside of skills that cause double damage (such as [[Frenzied Defense]]) or [[Armor_rating#Decrease armor rating on allies|armor reduction]] on their user. 
* Spirit Bond will trigger its healing before the damage is registered.
{{bug|Contrary to the descriptions, Spirit Bond will only end prematurely if it ''triggers'' ten times.}}
{{anomaly|Despite causing healing, triggering the healing from the skill does not cause [[Scourge Healing]] or [[Soul Bind]] to inflict damage.}}

== Trivia ==
